properties.entry: SELECT EMP_ID , EMP_NAME , SALARY , DEPT_TITLE , JOB_NAME FROM EMPLOYEE LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT ON (DEPT_CODE = DEPT_ID) JOIN JOB USING ( JOB_CODE ) ORDER BY EMP_ID DESC
SELECT EMP_ID , EMP_NAME , SALARY , DEPT_TITLE , JOB_NAME FROM EMPLOYEE E , DEPARTMENT D , JOB J WHERE E.DEPT_CODE = D.DEPT_ID AND E.JOB_CODE = J.JOB_CODE AND DEPT_TITLE = ? ORDER BY EMP_ID DESC
SELECT EMP_ID , EMP_NAME , SALARY , DEPT_TITLE , JOB_NAME FROM EMPLOYEE E , DEPARTMENT D , JOB J WHERE E.DEPT_CODE = D.DEPT_ID AND E.JOB_CODE = J.JOB_CODE AND JOB_NAME = ? ORDER BY EMP_ID DESC

SELECT EMP_ID , EMP_NAME , EMP_NO , EMAIL , PHONE , DEPT_TITLE , JOB_NAME , SALARY , SAL_LEVEL , BONUS , MANAGER_ID , HIRE_DATE , ENT_DATE , ENT_YN FROM EMPLOYEE E , DEPARTMENT D , JOB J WHERE E.DEPT_CODE = D.DEPT_ID AND E.JOB_CODE = J.JOB_CODE AND EMP_ID = ?
UPDATE EMPLOYEE SET SALARY = ? , DEPT_CODE = ? , JOB_CODE = ? WHERE EMP_ID = ?
UPDATE EMPLOYEE SET ENT_DATE = SYSDATE , ENT_YN = 'N' WHERE EMP_ID = ?
